retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 90s-inspired layout featuring massive 3D extruded red and gold typography set against a futuristic green techno-stage with dramatic lens flares.
triggerTerms: dramatic stage lighting with lens flares

recipe.visualDefinition: A maximalist composition dominated by a central stack of heavy 3D block lettering in red and gold, framed by a symmetrical array of green stage lights and intersecting white light beams.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance around a vertical central axis
High-contrast relationship between red foreground text and green background
Layered depth created by 3D extrusion and overlapping light beams
Repetition of circular stage light motifs in the periphery
coreInvariants: Heavy 3D extrusion on all primary display text
High-gloss metallic or chrome finish on text faces
Matrix-like green digital patterns in the background
Star-shaped lens flares at light intersections

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text stack is centered and occupies approximately 70% of the vertical space, scaled to feel monumental.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large '1990s' numerals in the lower-middle section act as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top headline, moves down through the large 'NOW' block, rests on the central year, and finishes at the bottom 'DELUXE' banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with light effects and geometric shapes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Emerald green background and stage lighting
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for the primary text faces
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Polished gold for the 3D extrusions and bevels
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast, creating a glowing, neon-like effect.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with a downward-facing perspective
Double-beveled edges on all primary glyphs
High-gloss specular highlights on the face of the letters
Horizontal banding within the 3D depth to simulate metallic layers
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '1' in the year features a sharp, angled top serif
The '0' and '9' are perfectly oval with thick, uniform strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monolithic stacking of varying weights of the same 3D style.
graphicDevices: Horizontal gold bars separating text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary bold, condensed skeleton for the 3D effect.
Matches the tight counters and heavy verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a futuristic 90s techno stage background with emerald green lighting, spherical chrome stage lights, and intersecting white light beams with star-shaped lens flares. Include a digital matrix-like texture in the dark areas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive 3D extruded text in a stacked formation. The text should have red faces with gold chrome bevels and deep gold extrusions. The central year should be the largest element.

verificationChecks: Is the text rendered with significant 3D depth?
Is the color palette strictly red, gold, and green?
Are there prominent lens flares at the light sources?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D perspective consistency across all letters
Ensure lens flares do not obscure the legibility of the text
Verify the green background has a digital/techno texture
Confirm the red and gold contrast is sharp and metallic
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D Extruded Typography + Techno Green Stage + Lens Flare Array = 90s Compilation Aesthetic
